entities.name: Ham1-like pyrophosphatase
observations: 177-aa sequence has a Ham1p-like domain (PF01725) and 65.9–67.6% identity to reviewed Listeria dITP/XTP pyrophosphatases across 99.4% query coverage.
Likely Mg2+-dependent nucleotide-triphosphate pyrophosphatase, with homologs preferring XTP, dITP, and ITP; proposed house-cleaning role is inferred, not demonstrated for this sequence.
Sequence-derived properties: 18,997 Da, pI 4.66, predicted charge at pH 7 −11.2; closest homolog is annotated homodimeric.
